diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a one-shot script with a 3-minute delay embedded in the body (period 0), whereas the IR specifies a repeating cycle with a 3-minute period. F2 shows a mismatch at 190000 ms: the IR initiates the second cycle (siren.setsirenmode), but the candidate is idle inside its internal 3-minute delay. F3 confirms the script contains the extra delay. The fix sets period to 180000 and removes the internal delay.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period from 0 to 180000 to enable repetition every 3 minutes. Removed delay(3 MIN) from the script body to match the IR cycle body duration.
